name: B. J. VanVleck
role: Mandan man; aided Billings County organization
bio: B. J. VanVleck of Mandan was named for register of deeds in October 1886. In November 1886 the Billings County commissioners paid him six dollars for services in organizing the county.

moments.label: Paid for services organizing Billings County

mentions: Howard Eaton shipped the last of his tame buffalo to B. J. VanVleck of Mandan, this morning.

…nomination at the same time of a full set of county officers. F. A. Briggs was nominated for treasurer, B. J. VanVleck for register of deeds, F. E. Bowen for district attorney, Geo. Harmon for sheriff and H. P. Hillis for auditor. It is hardly possible now to tell how the nomination will…
